answer: No — the article states that, unlike terrorism content, disinformation is not illegal in the EU per se. It says the DSA obliges X, as a very large online platform, to mitigate risks attached to harmful falsehoods and to act diligently on reports of illegal content [by_paragraph-dcc3e80f7bab3c578995032535df86d825d4b56abfbbfd449ad738496e887b84].
